sources.name: pqclab-snova-round2
sources.build_model: reference path only: -D OPTIMISATION=0 -D FIXED_ABQ=2; one translation-unit set per parameter set/backend/sk format
notes: The pinned HEAD of pqclab-snova/SNOVA is round 3; this lock deliberately stays on the round-2 commit that matches plans/specs/snova-round2-spec.pdf
Only the reference path is built; snova_plasma/optimised/AVX2 code is vendored but not linked, so cross-implementation oracles compare SSK/ESK storage formats rather than distinct implementations
The pinned round-2 source regenerates the official SNOVA_KAT count=0 responses byte-for-byte for the inspected profile

sources.name: pqclab-snova-kat-round2
notes: Official response files are ~20 MB each; scripts/generate_snova_fixtures.py extracts the count=0 record for all 44 parameter-set/backend/sk-format combinations into tests/fixtures/snova/kat_reference.json
The 75/33/2 responses are gzip-compressed in the upstream repository and are hashed in compressed form

spec_interpretations.issue: the expanded listing appears to omit some matrix elements
spec_interpretations.resolution: the model uses all l^2 row-major entries and checks them against equations (1.1)/(1.2) on p.26

spec_interpretations.issue: using l^2+l-1 as a ti/tj loop bound would run past an l^2 x l^2 coefficient matrix
spec_interpretations.resolution: the alpha term count is l^2+l; the model derives 0<=ti,tj<l^2 from the p.26 matrix equation and the linear-system dimension

spec_interpretations.issue: the printed row count adds an extra +l
spec_interpretations.resolution: the row count follows the m*l^2 equations of the coefficient system

spec_interpretations.location: p.29 signature vector and Algorithm 13 p.30
spec_interpretations.issue: the signature should carry n=v+o matrices rather than m, and i' must be computed inside each (i,alpha) term
spec_interpretations.resolution: the model follows the pinned source: n signature matrices, i'=(i+alpha)%m inside the term loop, alpha in [0,l^2+l)

spec_interpretations.issue: the prose/formula uses Ai,alpha while the expanded pseudocode omits some i indices
spec_interpretations.resolution: the expansion order is locked to the pinned round-2 source/KAT rather than guessed; source file/line locations are recorded in this lock

spec_interpretations.issue: the plan and one PDF reading use the 9-byte string "SNOVA ABQ" (with a space)
spec_interpretations.resolution: the pinned round-2 source calls gen_ABQ("SNOVA_ABQ") with an underscore; the source regenerates the official KAT, so the underscore string is authoritative for the fixed-ABQ model

kat.record: count=0 for all 11 parameter sets x {AES,SHAKE} x {SSK,ESK}
notes: The fixture is regenerable with a checkout of the pinned KAT commit; every response-file SHA-256 is embedded in the fixture
The 75/33/2 SHAKE-ESK and AES-ESK source responses are stored gzip-compressed upstream and hashed in that form
